title: Start unrelated coding tasks with fresh session context
outcome: Coders start unrelated work in a fresh session, or with a supported context reset, using a compact durable handoff instead of accumulating unrelated task history.
acceptance: Define a practical task-boundary rule: unrelated work starts with fresh context; related implementation, fixes and review rounds retain the context they need. Do not reset merely because a turn ended.

Before switching, record the completed or paused task's outcome, source/worktree, unresolved dependencies and exact evidence locators. Resolve or explicitly hand off active claims, gates, reviews and notifications; never transfer live authority implicitly or abandon a carried operation.

Use the host's supported fresh-session or context-reset route and recover current instructions plus a minimal task-specific brief. If neither safe route is available, record the limitation rather than pretending context was cleared.

Demonstrate the boundary with representative related and unrelated task scenarios, including an outstanding gate/review. The new task receives necessary governing context and locators without replaying the prior task's full transcript; exact token counts are not required.

completion.summary: Documented unrelated-task fresh-context procedure, preserved related-task context and outstanding ownership/delivery, supported creation/recovery evidence, five representative scenarios; reviewed, validated, independently accepted, committed, pushed and installed.
